title: Rotation Angles to Direction Cosine Matrix
text: Convert rotation angles to direction cosine matrix, 1 input, 1 output, {Rotation Order} sets Rotation order.

params.name: Rotation Order
params.values: Rotation order ZYX (default) | ZYZ | ZXY | ZXZ | YXZ | YXY | YZX | YZY | XYZ | XYX | XZY | XZX
